windows.title: Tendou Studio — Hybrid MoE Inference Engine

bundle.shortDescription: Tendou Studio — Hybrid MoE Inference Engine Desktop Control Plane
bundle.longDescription: Tendou Studio is the native Tauri v2 desktop control plane for Tendou Launcher v0.16.3, an independent 3-tier hybrid Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference engine featuring Zero-Copy THP Hot-RAM pinning, 512-bit AVX-512 MoE kernels, persistent ChatGPT-style chat history with context-growth telemetry, and OpenAI/Anthropic agent hubs.
